contributions.statement: Put one-click execution of code snippets inside the content-authoring step itself; when it was inline, 15/16 writers ran their generated code versus 3/14 who verified it with their usual LLM tools.
contributions.evidence: §5.2.1 Table 5 screen-recording counts, Fig. 8; n=16 within-subjects, 15-minute Python tutorial, heterogeneous control setups so the tool and the one-click affordance are confounded; no tutorial quality rating.
relative_to: shift-left verification / reduce friction for checks

reason: Human tutorial authoring, not coding agents; the behavioural count is concrete but confounded, so it is at most a hypothesis for LLM-drafted educational content.
